findingDetails.title: The 003 lift row says the full checkout adds a build log, but the log sits outside the checkout
findingDetails.scopeProof: claim at research.md:186; contradicting statement at research.md:479; log path specs/system-skilled-bots/context/openhuman-full.build.log read directly
findingDetails.case: a builder opens the openhuman-full checkout looking for the build log the row says the checkout adds, finds none, and cannot tell whether the crate was built

findingDetails.title: The 002 lift row names contracts/prompt-sections.md as the owner of the prompt order, and that file says phase 005 owns it
findingDetails.scopeProof: claim at research.md:196; cited line specs/system-skilled-bots/003-openbot-parity-build/contracts/prompt-sections.md:15 read directly
findingDetails.case: a builder told the contract owns the order edits contracts/prompt-sections.md to add the firing frame and leaves the phase 005 order document unchanged, so the two disagree
